title: Kavach phaad diya apne haathon se?
hooks: Kavach phaad diya... apne haathon se.
Amartya hoke bhi... maut chuni usne.
Indra ne maanga... sab kuch daan mein.
hook_why: Starts with the violent, voluntary act — tearing off divine armor — creating immediate shock and an incomplete thought that forces retention past 3 seconds. Matches the 'shock-fact/urgency' hook type that wins in this niche.
metaphor: Second Skin — the divine kavach as a living golden layer he chooses to shed, revealing that his true armor was never metal but generosity.

cast.Karna: Tall warrior with golden skin, wearing ornate golden kavach (armor) and kundal (earrings), long dark hair, calm dignified expression, traditional dhoti, soft divine light around him
cast.Indra_Brahmin: Old brahmin with white beard, simple cotton dhoti, kamandalu (water pot), humble posture, but eyes hold divine lightning
cast.Indra_True: Four-armed deva on Airavata elephant, golden crown, vajra in hand, radiant but only hinted in shadows and reflections — never fully shown

scenes.vo: Kavach phaad diya... apne haathon se, khoon aur roshni ek saath baha.
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up: golden kavach cracking at the chest, Karna's fingers digging into the seams, warm golden light bleeding through the fissures, slow motion tear, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon, soft divine light
scenes.title: Kavach phaad diya

scenes.vo: Karna janam se hi amartya tha, Surya ka vardaan.
scenes.prompt: Newborn Karna floating on a lotus in a celestial river, golden kavach and kundal already fused to his tiny body, soft divine glow, Surya's rays blessing him, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Janam se amartya

scenes.vo: Kavach-kundal uske shareer se chipke the, jaise doosri chamdi.
scenes.prompt: Young Karna standing, the kavach glowing like a second skin — intricate filigree patterns pulsing with light, kundal shimmering at ears, no visible seams, divine anatomy, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Doosri chamdi

scenes.vo: Koi shastra bhed na saka, teer toot ke bikhar gaye.
scenes.prompt: Battlefield: arrows, spears, chakras shattering on impact with Karna's chest, golden sparks flying, he stands untouched, calm, weapons turning to dust, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Koi shastra na bhed

scenes.vo: Ek din brahmin aaya daan maangne, suraj dhalte waqt van mein.
scenes.prompt: Forest hermitage at golden hour: old brahmin with kamandalu approaches Karna who sits in meditation, dappled light through trees, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Brahmin maanga daan

scenes.vo: Woh brahmin... Indra the chhup ke, parchhai mein char haath dikhe.
scenes.prompt: Same scene, but the brahmin's shadow on the ground shows four arms and a crown, lightning flickering in his eyes, Karna's gaze sharp with recognition, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon

scenes.vo: Indra ne maanga kavach-kundal, haath faila ke, aankhon mein bijli.
scenes.prompt: Brahmin's hand extended, palm up — requesting. Karna's kavach glows brighter at the gesture, kundal tremble at his ears, the air thick with divine tension, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Indra ne maanga

scenes.vo: Karna jaanta tha yeh maut hai, phir bhi man na dola.
scenes.prompt: Close on Karna's face: eyes half-closed, a single tear tracking down golden cheek, internal fire visible in his pupils — he sees his own death, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Maut nishchay

scenes.vo: Phir bhi usne daan diya muskura ke, ungliyon ne seem dhoondh nikali.
scenes.prompt: Karna's fingers find the seam at his throat, kavach peels away like golden silk, kundal slide off earlobes — he smiles, serene, blood wells but light pours out brighter, slow motion, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Daan diya muskura ke

scenes.vo: Kavach phaad ke khoon baha, har boond moti si chamki.
scenes.prompt: Golden armor and earrings in Karna's cupped hands, offered upward. His chest bare, blood trickling down golden skin, but each drop catches light like a gem. Indra's shadow receives the gift, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Khoon baha, moti si

scenes.vo: Amartya martya ho gaya, par uska tej aur badh gaya.
scenes.prompt: Karna stands vulnerable, no armor, no earrings — yet his aura expands, brighter than before. The forest glows around him. Indra's true form bows in the distance, unseen by others, painterly cinematic Indian miniature style, warm gold and deep maroon
scenes.title: Tej badh gaya

scenes.vo: Sacha bal kavach mein nahi, daan mein hai. Tu kya karta? Comment kar.
scenes.prompt: Dark maroon textured background with carved gold lattice edges. Center: large gold Roman 'DAAN' glowing, smaller Roman 'Sacha bal daan mein hai' below. Space for question at bottom.
scenes.title: Sacha bal daan mein

claims.claim: Karna was born with divine armor (kavach) and earrings (kundal) that made him invincible.
claims.basis: Mahabharata, Vana Parva (Araneya Parva), Chapters 290-295 — Karna's birth and divine gifts from Surya.

claims.claim: Indra, disguised as a brahmin, asked Karna for his kavach and kundal as alms.
claims.basis: Mahabharata, Vana Parva, Chapter 300 — Indra approaches Karna to weaken him before the Kurukshetra war.

claims.claim: Karna knew giving them away would make him mortal but gave them anyway due to his vow of never refusing alms.
claims.basis: Mahabharata, Vana Parva, Chapter 301 — Karna tears off his armor and earrings, bleeding, and offers them to Indra.

claims.claim: This event is from the Vana Parva (Book of the Forest) of the Mahabharata.
claims.basis: Critical Edition of Mahabharata, Vana Parva, Araneya Parva, Adhyayas 290-301.
